You help an SRE and media team choose an observability stack and a video pipeline in one program. Each main decision has a recorded reason, and both the decisions and their reasons change as the evaluations go on.

- [e007] Decision: the storage tier is now `cold-tier-glacier`.
- [e008] Agreed in the sync: the subtitle format becomes `scc-subs`.
- [e009] Decision: the packager is now `unified-pkg`.
- [e010] Update from Wren: the video player is set to `videojs-player`, effective now.
- [e011] After the review, the team settled on `telegraf-agent` for the telemetry collector.
- [e012] Decision: the ad server is now `spotx-ads`.
- [e013] Decision: the tracing backend is now `jaeger-tr`.
- [e014] Decision: the QoE monitor is now `mux-data`.
- [e015] Ivo confirmed in writing that the transcode farm changes to `elemental-farm`.
- [e016] After the review, the team settled on `openobserve` for the log store.
- [e017] Decision: the continuous profiler is now `pyroscope-prof`.
- [e018] Update from Uma: the video encoder is set to `svt-av1`, effective now.
- [e019] Agreed in the sync: the scrape interval in seconds becomes `14`.
- [e020] Decision: the exemplar storage flag is now `OFF`.
- [e021] Approved: `rm-CH` joins the supported locales of the player.
- [e022] Approved: `fo-FO` joins the supported locales of the player.
- [e023] From now on, the supported locales of the player include `kl-GL`.

- [e025] Decision: the log sampling flag is now `OFF`.
- [e026] Agreed in the sync: the bitrate ladder rung count becomes `12`.
- [e027] For the record, Dara wrote down the reason for the metrics backend decision: `why-security`.
- [e028] Hana recorded the reason for the alert router decision: `why-cost`.
- [e029] Lars recorded the reason for the incident tracker decision: `why-licensing`.

- [e031] Wren recorded the reason for the DRM vendor decision: `why-support`.
- [e032] For the record, Jun wrote down the reason for the uptime checker decision: `why-licensing`.

Rules for this task:
- A value changes only by an event that decides, corrects, adds, removes, renames, runs or restores it. A proposal, a question, a link or a quote of an old page changes nothing.
- A correction or a new decision replaces the earlier value. The earlier value is then superseded.
- The initial specification gives the first value of each item.
- A question about the values of an item "at some point" counts every value from the initial specification on, up to the time of the question.
- Each tool and each setting has one current decision. A new decision for it replaces the earlier one.
- A superseded value of an item is a value that was its decision at some time, the initial specification included, and is not its current decision.
- A locale is supported from the event that adds it until an event removes it.
- Some decisions have a recorded reason. A reason is one id of this closed list: `why-cost`, `why-latency`, `why-quality`, `why-licensing`, `why-scale`, `why-support`, `why-security`.
- Each decision with a recorded reason has one reason at a time. An entry that records a reason for it replaces the earlier reason.
- A new decision for such an item comes with an entry that records its reason. A later entry can replace the reason and keep the decision.
- A reason changes only by an entry that records it. A new decision with no such entry keeps the earlier reason. A proposed reason changes nothing.
Every event has a label of the form [eNNN] with a three-digit number. A higher number is later in time. A later event can change or cancel an earlier one.
Some material quotes old pages or copies for history. A quote of that kind is not a new statement.
